answer_1.quote: Text summarization aims at presenting salient points of a text, concisely and fluently... This paper addresses summarization of multiple news articles.
answer_1.outputs: Abstractive multi-document summaries generated by the EXPARCOM pipeline

answer_2.quote: We measure the performance of our models by automatic evaluation using ROUGE metric.

answer_4.quote: We design the following Amazon MTurk experiment: we randomly select 50 samples ... ask the human testers (3 per sample) to rank between outputs. The testers were required to scale (1-5, with 5 being of superior quality to 1) the system's output on informativeness, fluency and nonredundancy.
answer_4.guideline: Rate each system summary on a 1-5 scale for informativeness (coverage of reference), fluency (readability), and nonredundancy (lack of repetition).
